items.title: PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, 14.25, and 19 RC 2 Released!
items.summary: The PostgreSQL Global Development Group has released an update to allsupported versions of PostgreSQL, including 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and14.25, as well as the second release candidate of PostgreSQL 19. This releasefixes 52 security vulnerabilities and over 140 bugs reported over the lastseveral months.There are several issues that may require you to take extra steps afterupdating, which are described in detail below. See the "Updating" section formore information on post-update steps you may need to take.For the full list of changes, please review the releasenotes.PostgreSQL 14 EOL NoticeThis is the final release of PostgreSQL 14. PostgreSQL 14 is now end-of-lifeand will no longer receive security and bug fixes. If you are runningPostgreSQL 14 in a production environment, we suggest that you make plans toupgrade to a newer, supported version of PostgreSQL. Please see ourversioning policy for moreinformation.Security IssuesThe following security vulnerabilities are closed in this update release.You can find more details about the vulnerabilities and their affected versionsin the links below:CVE-2026-6460: Type confusion after ALTER ...
